name: AHNR 3001
title: CAHNR Peer Mentors
description: Students will serve as peer mentors for campus change and transfer students in CAHNR. Mentoring will primarily occur virtually, with in-person meetings an option. Students will meet with the instructor and TA to gain skills in mentoring and career path development for CAHNR students. Students must have completed AHNR 3001 and have approval of the instructor to register for this course. May be repeated for a total of 2 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
